data.name: Deliwhere?
data.detailed_description:
💸 A MASSIVE DEBT, A FLYING PLATFORM, AND YOU!

You owe 100,000 Credits to the galaxy's most ruthless cargo company, and the only way to pay it off is to deliver those damn packages on time! Gather your friends, jump onto the massive cargo platform, and set sail toward dangerous islands. But there’s a catch: This vehicle has no steering wheel!

⚖️ PHYSICS-BASED "WEIGHT STEERING"

Forget everything you know about flight simulators. To steer this platform, you need the collective intelligence (or stupidity) of your crew! The platform flies in the direction you apply weight. To move forward, everyone runs to the front. To dodge an obstacle, lean to the right. But be careful; if heavy cargo suddenly slides into a corner, the entire ship will tilt and dive in that direction!

📦 RISKY DELIVERIES AND CHAOS

Carrying normal boxes is easy. But what about a giant sphere that constantly rolls back and forth? Or anti-gravity cargo that flips your center of mass? Or what if a sudden rainstorm turns your platform into an ice rink? The slightest mistake will result in your cargo (and your friends) plummeting into the bottomless abyss.

🔧 UPGRADE YOUR RIDE OR PAY YOUR DEBT

After every delivery, the money you earn is dumped into the shared company vault (a giant glass jar in the middle of your Hangar). The choice is yours:

  • Will you use this money to pay off the bank debt?

  • Or will you buy massive new engines and auto-landing systems to carry even heavier cargo?

🎮 KEY FEATURES

  • 2-4 Player Co-Op: Yell at your friends, throw them off the platform, or work together to be the best couriers in the galaxy.

  • Role Equipment: Will you be the Rocket Driver, or the Catcher who grabs falling cargo mid-air with a hook? Pick your role and grab your giant gear!

  • Dynamic Hazards: Flying asteroids, sudden engine failures, and violent storms will turn your peaceful journey into a nightmare.

  • Physical Economy: No boring terminal menus here. Grab your hard-earned physical cash and literally dump it into the vault!

English*, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Turkish

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 or AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD is recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 SUPER or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD is recommended
